lines.t: Behold, I reveal to you a mystery concerning these I have chosen, of whom I am also sending, these who must remain and gather together, the second harvest, my witnesses, who shall shout the Lord's proclamation.
These shall be left according to the perception of men who remain upon the earth
In that they are taken according to those who were changed and come to know my dwelling place
For such is the way and power of the Lord
For those who come to live in me and move within my spirit
Yet how can they be both left and taken?
You ask, I tell you the truth
They shall be even as a rose in full bloom
Both uprooted and replanted in one swift stroke
For those who might have chosen who were of the special offering must be changed
Oh, how shall I send them and how shall they go from me?
By what means shall they endure when death stalks them as the prey for residents written
Unless those days were short and no flesh would be saved
Behold, they shall move through the multitude unhindered
Both seen and unseen, heard and rejected
They shall be as fine dressers in my vineyard manner promised until the time
Husband men in the great and terrible day of the Lord
Yet they shall by no means be given up as lambs
To the slaughter
For they shall all be mighty men
They shall roar like young lions
Behold with a resounding roar
I shall speak through them
And they shall make a great noise
Even in the midst of this most ungodly generation
A terrible sound assaulting the ears of this wicked multitude
Who hate my name and my coming
A loud shout, a blaring trumpet
Breaking down the walls, leaving them desolate
Yet to the wild weep the broken and refined
Weep those right for the second harvest
To them my witnesses shall be as a welcome rain
In the midst of a ten-year drought
A shelter from the heat at the height of summer
Even a singing dove set on a high branch
Beckoning all who hear to spy them out
Yes, these my chosen
Shall be left in the day of the Lord
As beacons to guide those
Who yet grovel in the dark
Seeking respite, a strong arm to lean upon
For those who yet lack a foothold
Servants who see clearly
The night has fallen
Therefore, beloved, trust in my ways
Run not ahead nor lag behind
Take my hand and embrace me tightly
For the time has come
Says the Lord
